headline: U.S. sanctions Iran-linked bitcoin insurance scheme for Strait of Hormuz ships
story: The Treasury Department said the Hormuz Safe platform accepted bitcoin and other digital assets as part of an alleged sanctions workaround tied to IRGC-backed shipping controls.
